what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5224131 Ukrainian refugees; Germany hosts the largest share, 22.5%, followed by Poland.
Czechia, the United Kingdom and Spain are the next largest hosts.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in each of those years.
Before that, it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory from 2014 to 2022, with the DPR and LPR among the government's opponents.

when.text: The number of Ukrainian refugees rose sharply between 2021 and 2022 and peaked at 5960362 in 2023.
By the end of 2025 the figure was 5224131.
Returns to Ukraine were highest in 2022 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in each host country, added up across all host countries.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
